build_diffusion_solver: build a DiffusionSolver from a DictConfig to train a MultiBand diffusion model for audio
run_diffusion_training_step: run a single training step on a batch of audio waveforms using the DiffusionSolver
regenerate_audio_waveform: regenerate a given audio waveform using the DiffusionSolver with optional step list
create_data_processor: create a DataProcess instance to apply frequency band filtering and resampling to audio data
evaluate_diffusion_model: evaluate the diffusion model on an audio dataset and compute RelativeVolumeMel metrics
